DCmc is a memory controller that enables a multicore dual-criticality system to achieve both high performance and tight timing guarantees.
DCmc enables a multicore system to achieve both goals of real-time and high performance, while providing a tight WCET estimation.
DCmc enables a high-performance and real-time memory controller that can be used to build a dual-criticality multicore processor.

the problem of how to control contention in the access of multicore memory by a dual-criticality application, in a way that enables both real-time and high performance goals to be met.
the design of a multicore system architecture that enables both real-time and high performance applications to coexist on the same multicore processor.
the design of a memory controller that enables the development of multicore dual-criticality systems in the space domain.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
DCmc enables a more efficient and effective design space exploration for multicore dual-criticality systems.
DCmc enables both high performance and real time, which is not possible with a standard memory controller.
DCmc is a very effective solution for space multicore dual-criticality systems, enabling the use of multicore processors in space missions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
DCmc enables a more effective use of the main memory, hence increasing the overall system performance.
DCmc enables the design of multicore dual-criticality systems, which can be used to design space systems with high-performance and real-time applications.

the design of the memory controller can be a critical element to achieve the goals of multicore Dual-Criticaly systems.
